spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker has transiently moved the Uniswap spot price (tradePrice) to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

oracle_used_by_flows.meaning: buyback and liquidity manager operations rely on UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice as their slippage guard

guard_passes_manipulated.meaning: the slippage guard passes for the attacker-manipulated tradePrice, reporting the manipulated price as within slippage limits

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked by buyback/liquidity manager operations as their slippage guard.
The attacker's spot-price move occurs before the guarded swap is checked.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric slippage bound or TWAP window, so the deviation-vs-bound comparison cannot be encoded numerically; the guard-pass outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: Only the guard_passes_manipulated impact is formalized; downstream swap execution, reserve drain and economic loss are separate passes.
The TWAP-vs-spot deviation relation is captured qualitatively via the guard-pass Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.
